verdicts.reason: A: the three price cards come out at very different sizes (Yearly is tiny, Family is medium, Monthly is large), are out of order, and the subtitle is wedged between them. The highlighted Yearly plan is demoted, and the CTA runs almost to the canvas edges. B makes the same out-of-order split, with the subtitle in the middle and Monthly left alone at the bottom. All its cards are shrunk to postage-stamp size, so their labels and sub-copy can't be read, and big dead gaps open around them. A at least keeps two of the prices legible.
